description: This PHP file defines a migration class for the OrangeHRM system, specifically for migrating database schemas and data related to version 5.3.0. It includes methods for schema modifications, data transformations, and handling of foreign keys, aiming to update the database schema and data to the new version requirements.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Migration class for handling database schema and data updates for OrangeHRM version 5.3.0, including schema modifications, data transformation, foreign key handling, and UTC time conversions.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the main migration operations including permission updates, language string management, schema changes, data conversions, and cleanup tasks.

methods.name: updateLangStringVersion
methods.description: Updates the version of language strings in the database.

methods.name: createColumnToStoreBuzzOriginalVideoLink
methods.description: Adds a new column for storing original video links and populates it with data from related tables.

methods.name: modifyBuzzTables
methods.description: Drops obsolete tables, columns, modifies character sets, and updates schema for Buzz-related tables.

methods.name: getConflictingForeignKeys
methods.description: Identifies foreign key constraints that conflict with existing schema, specifically with 'hs_hr_employee'.

methods.name: removeConflictingForeignKeys
methods.description: Drops foreign key constraints that conflict with the desired schema.

methods.name: recreateRemovedForeignKeys
methods.description: Restores foreign keys that were dropped after schema is stabilized.

methods.name: changeBuzzTablesDateTimeColumnsAsNotNull
methods.description: Alters specific datetime columns to be NOT NULL.

methods.name: convertBuzzCommentTableTimesToUTC
methods.description: Converts timestamps in the Buzz comment table to UTC.

methods.name: convertBuzzLikeOnCommentTableTimesToUTC
methods.description: Converts timestamps in the Buzz like-on-comment table to UTC.

methods.name: convertBuzzLikeOnShareTableTimesToUTC
methods.description: Converts timestamps in the Buzz like-on-share table to UTC.

methods.name: convertBuzzPostTableTimesToUTC
methods.description: Converts timestamps in the Buzz post table to UTC.

methods.name: convertBuzzShareTableTimesToUTC
methods.description: Converts timestamps in the Buzz share table to UTC.

methods.name: getTableRecordCount
methods.description: Returns the count of records in a specified table.

methods.name: convertServerTimeToUTCTime
methods.description: Converts a given DateTime from server time to UTC.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Instantiates or returns the existing LangStringHelper object for language string operations.
